title: ECLIPSE: Embedding-Centered Foundation-Model Federated Knowledge Transfer for Data-Free Edge Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2611.31527v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation Models (FMs) are envisioned to become an integral component of intelligent federated edge networks because of their strong representation and generalization capabilities. However, their integration into resource-constrained and privacy-sensitive edge environments remains challenging. This challenge is particularly pronounced in data-free settings, where no shared, public, or server-accessible reference dataset is available to establish a common reference space for aligning distributed knowledge. To address this challenge, we propose ECLIPSE, which is an embedding-centered FM-based federated knowledge transfer framework developed for data-free edge intelligence. ECLIPSE enables edge intelligence capitalizing on a server-hosted FM without sharing raw data, local models, or a public reference dataset. translated_title: ECLIPSE：面向无数据边缘智能的以嵌入为中心的基础模型联邦知识迁移框架
translated_abstract: 基础模型凭借其强大的表征和泛化能力，被认为将成为智能联邦边缘网络不可或缺的组成部分。然而，将其集成到资源受限且对隐私敏感的边缘环境中仍然面临挑战。这一挑战在无数据场景下尤为突出，因为在此类场景中不存在共享的、公开的或服务器可访问的参考数据集，无法建立用于对齐分布式知识的公共参考空间。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了ECLIPSE，一个专为无数据边缘智能设计的、以嵌入为中心的基于基础模型的联邦知识迁移框架。ECLIPSE利用服务器托管的基础模型实现边缘智能，而无需共享原始数据、本地模型或公共参考数据集。它建立了一个共享的嵌入参考空间，边缘设备通过该空间对其本地任务知识进行编码，仅由此产生的嵌入结果……
tldr: 该论文提出ECLIPSE框架，以嵌入为中心，利用服务器托管的基础模型建立共享嵌入参考空间，在不共享原始数据、本地模型或公共数据集的前提下实现无数据场景下的联邦知识迁移与边缘智能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ECLIPSE, an embedding-centered federated knowledge transfer framework that leverages a server-hosted foundation model to establish a shared embedding reference space, enabling data-free edge intelligence without sharing raw data, local models, or any public reference dataset.
